verses.1: A Psalm of David, when he was in the desert of Idumea.
verses.2: O God, my God: to you, I keep vigil until first light. For you, my soul has thirsted, to you my body, in so many ways.
verses.3: By a deserted land, both inaccessible and waterless, so I have appeared in the sanctuary before you, in order to behold your virtue and your glory.
verses.4: For your mercy is better than life itself. It is you my lips will praise.
verses.5: So will I bless you in my life, and I will lift up my hands in your name.
verses.6: Let my soul be filled, as if with marrow and fatness; and my mouth will give praise with exultant lips.
verses.7: When I have remembered you on my bed in the morning, I will meditate on you.
verses.8: For you have been my helper. And I will exult under the cover of your wings.
verses.9: My soul has clung close to you. Your right hand has supported me.
verses.10: Truly, these ones have sought my soul in vain. They will enter into the lower parts of the earth.
verses.11: They will be delivered into the hand of the sword. They will be the portions of foxes.
verses.12: Truly, the king will rejoice in God: all those who swear by him will be praised, because the mouth of those who speak iniquity has been blocked. [ Psalm 63 ] (64)
